aniimo-release-date.title: Aniimo Release Date: Global Launch Time and Pre-Registration
aniimo-release-date.subtitle: Aniimo launches globally on September 16, 2026 at 10:00 UTC+8.
aniimo-release-date.lead: Aniimo is scheduled to launch globally on September 16, 2026 at 10:00 UTC+8 as a free-to-play title. Steam may show September 15 because storefront dates vary by region and time zone.

body.c: What is the Aniimo release date?
The PlayStation Store states that Aniimo will officially launch on September 16, 2026 at 10:00 UTC+8. That is September 16 at 02:00 UTC and September 15 at 10:00 PM Eastern Daylight Time.
Why does Steam show September 15?

The Steam listing checked in the United States displays Sep 15, 2026. This is consistent with a simultaneous global launch crossing calendar dates in different time zones; the UTC+8 time above is the explicit launch time published by PlayStation.
Is Aniimo free to play?
Yes. PlayStation, Xbox and Steam describe Aniimo as free-to-play. Optional pre-order packs and in-app purchases are separate from access to the base game.
Can I pre-register now?
The official Aniimo website currently offers pre-registration and links to its supported storefronts. Use the official site or the store page for your platform rather than unofficial download sites.
Release information was last checked on August 29, 2026. Store dates can display differently by region.

what-is-aniimo.title: What Is Aniimo? Gameplay, Twine and Open-World Features
what-is-aniimo.subtitle: An official-source overview of Aniimo and how its core gameplay works.
what-is-aniimo.lead: Aniimo is a free-to-play creature-catching open-world RPG from Pawprint Studio. Players explore Idyll, capture Aniimo, Twine with collected creatures and take part in solo, multiplayer and competitive activities.

body.c: What kind of game is Aniimo?

Official store descriptions call Aniimo a next-generation creature-catching open-world RPG. Its core loop combines exploration, collecting creatures, using their abilities, solving puzzles and taking part in real-time battles and challenges.
What does Twine mean in Aniimo?

Twine lets a Pathfinder become an Aniimo they have collected and use that creature’s abilities. Official examples include gliding, diving and burrowing to explore, solve puzzles, battle and overcome environmental challenges.
How does catching work?

Official store text says players catch Aniimo with Aniipods, can set traps and must time catches. Creatures may appear according to environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Exact probability formulas are not published in the sources used here.
Does Aniimo have multiplayer?
Yes. Steam lists multiplayer, PvP, online co-op and cross-platform multiplayer. Xbox describes Egg Heist as a real-time PVEVP activity for three-player teams, alongside solo and multiplayer play.
Who makes Aniimo?
Steam lists Pawprint Studio as both developer and publisher.
This overview separates verified official features from dex stats, type multipliers and catch-rate formulas that remain under review.

abilities.howToDescription: These official field abilities identify Aniimo that can support particular movement or environmental interactions. Open an ability group to compare its listed members.

combat.question: Are mobility abilities the same as combat skills?
combat.answer: No. Mobility covers exploration and field interaction. Traits and combat skills are listed separately on each Aniimo dex page.

complete.question: Is every Aniimo assigned a mobility ability?
complete.answer: No. Only mappings explicitly present in the official Wiki detail snapshot are shown; an unlisted ability is not guessed.
